engineeringSkip.reason: Quarks cannot exist in isolation because of colour confinement, so 'assembling' stable macroscopic lattices from quarks and gluons is not a technology grounded in known physics — the described uses (singularity shells, warp-drive rings) are speculative science fiction.

factCheck.reason: Quarks cannot be isolated or assembled into stable bulk matter — the strong force confines them permanently inside protons and neutrons, so building structures from free quarks is ruled out by known physics.
